---
title: "Exploratory Data Analysis - Vent-Flow Severity"
output: html_document
date: "2025-06-07"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(corrplot)
library(gridExtra)

# Read cleaned dataset
df <- read.csv("C:/Users/megha/Vent-Flow-Project-files/cleaned_vent_flow_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
str(df)
summary(df)

```

```{r}
# Evaluate class imbalance
table(df$Classification)
prop.table(table(df$Classification)) * 100

ggplot(df, aes(x = Classification, fill = Classification)) +
  geom_bar(width = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Non Serious" = "steelblue", "Serious" = "firebrick")) +
  labs(title = "Vent-Flow Event Severity Distribution", 
       x = "Event Classification", 
       y = "Count")
```


```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Classification, y = Flow_Rate_m3_day, fill = Classification)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Flow Rate (Log Scale)", y = "m3/day")

p2 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Classification, y = Stabilized_Shut_In_Pressure_kPa, fill = Classification)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Shut-In Pressure", y = "kPa")

grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2)
```
```{r}
table(df$Flow_Substance, df$Classification)

ggplot(df, aes(x = Flow_Substance, fill = Classification)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Event Classification by Flow Substance", 
       x = "Flow Substance", 
       y = "Count")
```
